payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (merged f092810). OtelConfig from FRICK_OTEL_* (enabled/endpoint/service_name/headers/sample_ratio; honors FRICK_OTEL_ENDPOINT + the spec/Compose FRICK_OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT + OTEL_* fallback). crate::telemetry::install_tracing wires the tracing-subscriber registry (fmt+EnvFilter) + an OTLP HTTP/protobuf layer when enabled, returning a guard that flushes on drop; wired in main.rs behind FRICK_OTEL_ENABLED (off by default). OTLP via opentelemetry-otlp http-proto + reqwest-rustls (no gRPC transport / openssl). Config + layer-construction unit-tested; live push needs a collector. Traces-only (per-request spans + metrics are a follow-up).
